Types introduced in import, along with array abbreviations (PS: CustomType []), cause the output .zod content to be empty.
## Bug description

Types introduced in import, along with array abbreviations (PS: CustomType []), cause the output .zod content to be empty.

### Input

```ts
import { ReferenceLine } from './internal/reference-line';

export interface Global {
    referenceLines?: ReferenceLine[] | null;
}

```

### Expected output

```ts
// Generated by ts-to-zod
import { z } from "zod";

import { referenceLineSchema } from "./internal/reference-line.zod";

export const globalSchema = z.object({
  referenceLines: z.array(referenceLineSchema).optional().nullable(),
});
```

### Actual output

```ts
// Generated by ts-to-zod
import { z } from "zod";

import { referenceLineSchema } from "./internal/reference-line.zod";
```

**Versions**

- Typescript: `v5.4.5`
- Zod: `v3.22.4`
